terms.definition: Scarcity and Opportunity Cost is a core topic in Grade 9 Economics covering essential principles on pages 37-50.
terms.definition_amharic: ስካርሲቲ (Scarcity) እና ኦፖርቹኒቲ ኮስት (Opportunity Cost) በ9ኛ ክፍል ኢኮኖሚክስ (Economics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 37-50 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
